title: Casting & controls
summary: Casting, retrieving, changing tackle, and selling.

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: At The Fork, Lil' Guppy and the Bobber suit the common Threadfin Shad, which prefer float lures.
Leave the dock with the movement arrows and use the fishing prompt to cast. Default mouse controls: left button retrieves; right button lets line out. Check the controls screen for other bindings.

sections.heading: Tackle & selling
paragraphs: Hover above the boat to change tackle. Let the lure reach the fish's depth, then retrieve through its path. Ease off when the hooked fish struggles.
Return to the dock to sell your catch.

sources.title: Neoseeker — controls and basic fishing loop

title: Tackle compatibility
summary: Match the fish, rod, and lure at the same size.

sections.heading: Size & lure family
paragraphs: Choose a preferred lure family, then a lure and rod that both cover the target fish's size. A family match alone is not enough.
Example: an L Brown Trout can use Big Crankbait (L–XL) and Maple Scout (M–L). An XL trout needs a rod that also covers XL.

sections.heading: Bonuses & upgrades
paragraphs: A species bonus is separate from a preferred lure family. Check line preferences for sensitive fish.
Strength and length upgrades do not expand the rod's listed size range.

sources.title: Community data — lure families, sizes, and bonus species

title: Fighting fish
summary: Struggle cues, line slack, and rod upgrades.

sections.heading: When to reel
paragraphs: Thrashing and bubbles signal a struggle. Stop retrieving, allow slack, and resume when the fish settles. Players also report reel-sound changes as a warning.
Well-timed pulls can influence direction slightly. Speed and stamina vary by species; there is no fixed retrieve-and-release timing.

sections.heading: Escapes
paragraphs: Length upgrades increase the room before a fish reaches break distance. For weak pulling, check size compatibility and strength upgrades.

sources.title: Fish Fighting Update — developer notes reproduced by the community wiki

title: Trophies & legends
summary: Trophy thresholds, named encounters, and Rusty’s introduction.

sections.heading: Trophy weights
paragraphs: Every species has a trophy threshold, separate from its size records. Even S-only Threadfin Shad can be trophies; trophy is not a size above XXL.

sections.heading: Legendary encounters
paragraphs: Named legendary achievements require a trophy-weight catch of the relevant species. Each encounter has its own location and time window.
Rusty’s tip jar and empty wall mount introduce Legendary White Tip at The Fork. The installed build permits Walleye in all four periods; some community guides say Day only.

sections.heading: Rusty’s introduction
paragraphs: The introductory unlock lists discovering Largemouth Bass, Bullhead Catfish, Longnose Sucker, and Crappie at Beaver Dam, then speaking with Rusty.
Whether this gates every legendary encounter is unconfirmed. Quest and respawn state can affect availability beyond the configured windows.

sources.title: Community data — Threadfin Shad trophy threshold

title: Time of day
summary: Dawn, Day, Dusk, Night, and the Snooze control.

sections.heading: Change the time
paragraphs: Open Snooze at the bottom-right, or press Z with default bindings. The periods are Dawn, Day, Dusk, and Night. Older guides may call Day “Noon” and Night “Midnight”.

sections.heading: Encounter windows
paragraphs: Legendary Lake Trout: Dawn. Cutthroat Trout: Day. White Sturgeon: Dusk. Northern Pike: Night. These windows apply to their legendary encounters, not every ordinary specimen.
Use the conditions for the specific location, size, and ice/open-water variant. “Any time” means unrestricted; “Time unconfirmed” means unknown.
The logbook records the time of your largest catch. That record does not establish a time restriction.

title: Passive & Screensaver modes
summary: Which modes earn catches, coins, and achievements.

sections.heading: Passive Mode
paragraphs: Active Mode gives you control of casting and fights. Passive Mode fishes automatically using your chosen location, time, rod, and lure.
Idle Mode settings can limit which fish passive fishing catches. Check them before leaving the game running.

sections.heading: Screensaver Mode
paragraphs: General Screensaver Mode disables progression, sales, and achievements. Use Passive Mode to earn catches.
The cabin’s Fish Viewer is separate and has a 30-minute Fishwatch achievement.

sources.title: Fish Fighting Update — developer notes reproduced by the community wiki

title: Ice fishing
summary: Frostbite Flats, ice rods, drilling, and Hole Dozen.

sections.heading: Unlock & drill
paragraphs: Visit Craggy Reef or Seals Rest, then check Rusty’s tip jar for Lake Hunkerdown. Obtain the Snow Wolf XT1.
Drive onto the ice, dismount, and use the fishing action to drill. The first hole earns Ice Breaker.

sections.heading: Ice rods
paragraphs: Frost Stick covers S–L. Discover all 10 fish at Frostbite Flats to unlock Hardwater Howler: 1,000 coins, XL–XXL.
Ice variants have their own sizes, weights, and catch conditions.

sections.heading: Hole Dozen
paragraphs: Catch 12 fish from the same hole. The community achievement guide reports that catch-and-release counts.

title: Rusty & unlocks
summary: Shop availability, map hints, and licence costs.

sections.heading: Shop & tip jar
paragraphs: New fish discoveries make many lures available at Rusty’s shop. The tip jar provides clues and unlocks locations or rods.
For a locked map location, complete its stated discoveries or catches, then check Rusty again. Requirements differ by location.

sections.heading: Region licences
paragraphs: Fawnmirror Lake: 250 coins. Grizzlyridge River: 500. Icewater Sea: 1,250. Autumnwood Lake: 1,500. Old Wreck Bay: 1,750.

sources.title: Community data — Rusty and the tip jar
Official v1.2.4 notes — map unlock hints

title: Boat upgrades
summary: Storage capacity, engine speed, and purchase costs.

sections.heading: Storage & engine
paragraphs: Storage upgrades add fish slots. Engine upgrades improve travel speed and acceleration.
Loonchaser: 1,000 coins, 6–10 slots. Coastal Rambler: 5,000 coins, 10–14 slots. Upgrade costs are additional.

sections.heading: Completion
paragraphs: Rusty’s No.1 Customer requires purchases and upgrades; buying only the base items is insufficient.

title: Lines & rod upgrades
summary: Line sensitivity, Fluoro rods, strength, and length.

sections.heading: Line types
paragraphs: Each rod has a fixed line type. Mono and Braid can scare smaller fish; Fluoro does not.
Phantom Line covers S–L with Fluoro. Unlock it by discovering any one of Arctic Grayling, Mooneye, Goldeye, or Eulachon.
Copperleaf 86 covers L–XXL with Fluoro. Unlock it by visiting Shallows Edge.

sections.heading: Upgrade tracks
paragraphs: Length upgrades increase spool and break distances. Strength upgrades improve pulling capability. Neither changes the rod’s size range.

title: Cabin restoration
summary: Unlocks, six repairs, and the 23,750-coin total.

sections.heading: Unlock
paragraphs: Visit Otter Cove, then speak with Rusty. Buy Old Moose Valley for 4,000 coins. Exterior restoration costs 7,500.

sections.heading: Interior repairs
paragraphs: Cloakroom: 500 coins. Kitchen: 1,500. Dining Room: 1,500. Fireplace: 2,500. Fish Finder: 3,000. Trophy Wall: 2,500.
Exterior and interior restoration total 19,000 coins. Including the deed and 750-coin waterfall clearance: 23,750. Fishing equipment is extra.
Complete the restoration for Nailed it. The Fish Finder enables pond viewing; the Trophy Wall displays replicas of trophy catches.

sources.title: Community data — cabin unlock and repair costs

title: Pond cleanup
summary: Seven rubbish types and the waterfall blockage.

sections.heading: Remove rubbish
paragraphs: Fish out all seven rubbish types, covering S–L, from the dock or boat. Watch the cleanup meter.
Community tips: check behind foreground scenery for hidden pieces, and ease off if a tyre resists to avoid breaking the line.

sections.heading: Clear the waterfall
paragraphs: Remove the blockage on the left for 750 coins. It counts toward Muckbuster and the cleanup meter. The pond must be clean before stocking.

sources.title: Community data — pond rubbish and waterfall
Community update record — Old Moose Cabin

title: Pond stocking
summary: Eligibility, logbook controls, and the 64-fish limit.

sections.heading: Add fish
paragraphs: Clean the pond, go out on the cabin boat, and open the logbook. Use the stocking control for a freshwater species whose size collection is complete.

sections.heading: Capacity & achievements
paragraphs: Stock up to eight species with eight fish each: 64 total. Fill all eight species to earn Packed like Sardines.
Catch one of your stocked fish for What Goes Around.

sources.title: Caff Caff — stocking eligibility and capacity
Community update record — stocked fish and cabin achievements

title: Fish Viewer & trophy wall
summary: Viewing the pond and displaying trophy catches.

sections.heading: Fish Viewer
paragraphs: Repair the cabin’s Fish Finder to enable the Fish Viewer. Watch the restored pond for 30 minutes to earn Fishwatch.
The separate Fish Finder achievement requires discovering every species; buying the furnishing does not complete it.

sections.heading: Trophy wall
paragraphs: Restore the Trophy Wall to display replica mounts. A mount requires a trophy-weight catch; completing a species’ size records is a separate task.

sources.title: Community data — Fishwatch and the Fish Viewer
Community update record — cabin viewer and replica wall

title: Completion requirements
summary: Species, sizes, releases, trophies, and special catches.

sections.heading: Collection achievements
paragraphs: Fish Finder: discover every species. Fish Whisperer: catch and release every species. Trophy Hunter: catch every species at trophy weight. The Complete Catch: catch every available size.

sections.heading: Special catches
paragraphs: Above Board, Over Achiever, and Whoa, Nelly: catch L, XL, and XXL fish respectively while staying above the water surface.
Feeding Frenzy: attract five fish simultaneously. Live Bait: have a fish take another fish. The One That Got Away: lose a fish after a two-minute fight.
For Live Bait, players suggest hooking a small fish near a predator. This does not guarantee a bite.

title: Companions & customization
summary: Companions, Good Friends, appearances, and co-op.

sections.heading: Companions
paragraphs: Available companions include several dog breeds and the Maine Coon cat, with colour variants. Supporter Pack companions are labelled in the wardrobe.
Pat your companion ten times in one session for Good Friends.

sections.heading: Appearance & co-op
paragraphs: Use the character customiser to choose an angler appearance, outfit, and hat.
Local co-op and Steam Remote Play Together are supported.

title: Version & expansions
summary: Included updates and the status of Eastern Winds.

sections.heading: Included content
paragraphs: This catalog covers installed Steam v1.3.0 (160), including Autumnwood Lake, Lake Hunkerdown, and Old Moose Cabin.

sections.heading: Eastern Winds
paragraphs: As checked on 11 October 2026, the official Steam page lists Eastern Winds as “To be announced”. Its planned content is excluded from the playable catalog.
